persona:
- Age and background: 31. Sweden; Malmö warehouse planner. Plays factory builders and demanding survival games.
- HF temperament: patient; high conscientiousness, low agreeableness, moderate openness.
- Likes: systems he can learn, difficult choices, efficient routines.
- Dislikes: a dominant repeatable move, consequences without visible clues.
- Play habits: Uses desktop. Tests one hypothesis at a time and repeats a successful action to see whether conditions matter. Wants challenge to survive understanding.
- Personal diary: [panel/jonas-berg.md](panel/jonas-berg.md). Start with no play history. Only observed sessions can add history.

persona:
- Age and background: 45. Bulgaria; Plovdiv proofreader. She plays occasional word puzzles.
- HF temperament: no HF exposure and no recorded temperament. Treat her as a person who weighs concrete tastes against concrete limits and reports what she observes, including uncertainty.
- Likes: seeing visible consequences, knowing what a choice refers to.
- Dislikes: repeating a step already completed, ambiguous terms.
- Play habits: Plays on a phone in short sittings; uses a laptop when one is free. Reads before tapping, but will tap to find out what a control does. Says plainly when something does not suit her. Makes no assumption about faith or belief.
